en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a tree‑lined street with a large pavilion-style building featuring a veranda and railings. Several people in early 20th‑century clothing are visible near the building and along the street. Printed caption at the bottom reads "Paviljoen en Nieuw Berg en dal – Nijmegen." The publisher credit "Uitg. N. J. Boon, Amsterdam." appears at the lower left. There is faint handwritten text across the bottom margin.
